title: WHEN YOU FEAR
STUMBLING TODAY
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

peaceful cottage window early morning light
open Bible on rustic table soft sunlight
calm countryside home golden hour glow
olive branches on wooden table beside Bible
cozy family home interior evening light
tranquil garden path bathed in sunlight
warm lit candle on wooden table near scripture

scenes.a: Your quiet fear of stumbling today is real.
scenes.sub: WHEN YOU FEAR YOU MIGHT SLIP

scenes.a: When you carry the weight of your household and worry you will slip, remember what is written in Jude.
Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
scenes.sub: KEPT FROM FALLING BY HIS GRACE

scenes.a: To the only wise God our Savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Lord, guard our home when our strength falters.
Hold our children and keep our steps steady in your truth.
We rest our family in your keeping power.
Amen, for your quiet fear of stumbling.
